name: 2-SAT Misdirection
description: We reframe the temporal state-machine constraints as explicit boolean prohibitions ("prohibited for both to be 1", "prohibited for both to be 2"). This strongly triggers surface-level pattern matching for 2-SAT. However, standard SCC-based 2-SAT solvers do not naturally produce the lexicographically smallest assignment required by the tie-break, meaning models that blindly apply a generic 2-SAT template will fail. Models that genuinely reason about the structure will recognize that these rules simply mean adjacent nodes must have different flags, reducing it to a standard bipartite graph where a simple BFS naturally satisfies the lexicographical requirement.
